claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_on_hit_rider (ClassFeatureMechanics family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Strike branch is a passive always-on weapon-hit damage rider. ClassFeatureMechanics only has 'activation' family which requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence + effect. A passive on-hit rider has none of these — it fires automatically on every weapon attack hit with no quota consumed and no reset cadence.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage of your Divine Strike increases to 2d8.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: cantrip_damage_trigger (ClassFeatureMechanics family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Potent Spellcasting branch fires an optional rider when the cleric casts a Cleric cantrip and deals damage. No existing family covers a spell-cast-triggered optional effect with no activation cost or resource. It is not a player-initiated activation; it fires on a specific spell-cast-plus-damage event.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you cast a Cleric cantrip and deal damage to a creature with it, you can give vitality to yourself or another creature within 60 feet of yourself...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_temp_hp (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Potent Spellcasting grants Temporary Hit Points, not regular HP healing. Temporary HP is mechanically distinct — it forms a separate buffer, does not stack with other temp HP, and is not equivalent to healing. The existing heal_hp effect covers regular HP restoration only.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: granting a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability_modifier_times (DiceAmount variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Temp HP amount is '2 × Wisdom modifier' — a scalar multiple of an ability score modifier. DiceAmount supports fixed dice, threshold tiers, and linear-per-level, but cannot express derived-from-ability-score amounts. A new variant such as { kind: 'ability_modifier_times'; ability: Ability; multiplier: number } is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: granting a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: branch_choice upgrade meta-structure
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Improved Blessed Strikes upgrades whichever of the two Blessed Strikes options the cleric selected at L7. The surface has no way to represent a feature that upgrades one of N prior choices. This is a branch-choice structure at the ClassFeatureRecord level — the L14 feature is semantically bound to the L7 choice.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful.
